# LAMB Reference Source

`torch_optimizer_lamb.py` is an unchanged source snapshot of
[`torch_optimizer/lamb.py`](https://github.com/jettify/pytorch-optimizer/blob/master/torch_optimizer/lamb.py)
from **torch-optimizer**, by Nikolay Novik and contributors.

Copyright 2020 Nikolay Novik (https://github.com/jettify).

The upstream project distributes this code under the Apache License, Version
2.0. The [license text](LICENSE) accompanies this snapshot; the copyright
attribution above is retained from the
[upstream license](https://github.com/jettify/pytorch-optimizer/blob/master/LICENSE).
Redistribution must preserve the applicable license, attribution and notices;
modified versions must identify their changes. The source's own references to
the LAMB paper and earlier implementation remain intact.

The numerical optimizer comparison uses this file as a reference for the update
equations, not as a standalone installed `torch_optimizer` package. In
particular, the snapshot retains its upstream relative `.types` import.

The [snapshot record](provenance.json) identifies the original download URL,
byte count and SHA-256. The historical download did not record a Git commit;
the moving `master` URL must not be treated as a pinned revision. The source
bytes have not been changed.
